scenes.narration: An airport got so many complaints about baggage delays that it hired more staff.
scenes.visual: carousel, person, bar-chart — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Bags came out faster. The complaints didn't stop. So they tried something that shouldn't have worked.
scenes.visual: carousel, arrow-up, question-mark, person — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: The fix took no extra staff, no new equipment, and made the wait objectively longer.
scenes.visual: clock, arrow-up, checkmark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Start with the thing everyone gets wrong about waiting. You don't experience a wait as a length of time.
scenes.visual: clock, hourglass, question-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: You experience it as a length of attention.
scenes.visual: brain, eye, hourglass — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Researchers have measured this repeatedly. People asked to wait with nothing to do consistently overestimate how long they waited — often by a lot.
scenes.visual: empty-room, clock, person, bar-chart — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Give them something to occupy attention and the same wait shrinks.
scenes.visual: clock, checkmark, brain, hourglass — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: This is why the wait for a lift feels endless and the walk to a further lift doesn't, even when the walk takes more of your life.
scenes.visual: person, corridor, clock, exit-door — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: There's a second layer, and it's the reason a wait can feel unfair rather than just long.
scenes.visual: queue, question-mark, scale — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Waits feel worse when you can't see the end, when you don't know why you're waiting.
scenes.visual: queue, corridor, question-mark, x-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: And — most powerfully — when someone who arrived after you gets served first.
scenes.visual: queue, person, arrow-up, x-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: That last one is why a single winding queue feeding several tills feels fairer than separate lines, even though the average wait is the same.
scenes.visual: queue, queue, scale, checkmark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: The single queue removes the possibility of picking wrong.
scenes.visual: queue, checkmark, exit-door — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: The airport looked at the numbers and found something strange.
scenes.visual: carousel, bar-chart, question-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Passengers walked about one minute from the gate to baggage claim, then stood at the carousel for about seven.
scenes.visual: corridor, carousel, clock, person — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Roughly eight minutes total. But only one of those minutes was occupied.
scenes.visual: clock, bar-chart, hourglass — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Seven were spent doing nothing but waiting, which is exactly the kind of time that stretches.
scenes.visual: empty-room, hourglass, person, clock — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: So they moved the arrival gates further from the terminal, and routed the bags to the most distant carousel.
scenes.visual: corridor, carousel, arrow-up, exit-door — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Passengers now walked about six minutes and waited about two.
scenes.visual: corridor, person, clock, carousel — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Complaints dropped to near zero.
scenes.visual: bar-chart, arrow-down, checkmark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Nothing got faster. The total journey was the same or slightly worse.
scenes.visual: clock, scale, hourglass — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: They simply converted empty waiting into occupied walking, and the experience of the wait collapsed.
scenes.visual: corridor, empty-room, checkmark, person — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Which raises the obvious objection: isn't this just manipulation? You're not being served faster. You're being managed.
scenes.visual: person, question-mark, x-mark, scale — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Sometimes, yes. A progress bar that lies about progress is a lie.
scenes.visual: progress-bar, x-mark, clock — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: And a made-up your call is important to us queue position is worse than silence.
scenes.visual: phone, queue, x-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: But a wait with a visible end, a stated reason, and something to do is genuinely a better experience — not a trick.
scenes.visual: progress-bar, checkmark, clock, eye — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Just a design that accounts for the fact that a person is standing there. The line is whether the design respects the wait or disguises it.
scenes.visual: person, scale, checkmark, x-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Two useful things. The first is diagnostic. When a wait feels unbearable, check whether it's actually long or merely empty.
scenes.visual: hourglass, empty-room, question-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Because those have completely different fixes, and you've probably been applying the wrong one.
scenes.visual: hourglass, empty-room, x-mark, checkmark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: The second is that you can do to yourself what the airport did to its passengers. Not distraction for its own sake — occupation.
scenes.visual: person, corridor, checkmark, brain — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Deciding in advance what the wait is for turns dead time into something with a shape.
scenes.visual: clock, calendar, checkmark, hourglass — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: And when a company makes you wait in a blank room with no information and no estimate, now you know that's a choice.
scenes.visual: empty-room, person, x-mark, question-mark — drawn in order, pen only

scenes.narration: Every one of those is fixable, cheaply, and they've decided not to. The wait was never the problem. It was the emptiness inside it.
scenes.visual: empty-room, clock, carousel, queue, corridor, bar-chart — drawn in order, pen only
